t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are 2 groups of gnomes, earth colours and non earth colours. The earth colours tend to score higher, but this changes randomly throughout the game so don't rely on this fully.

vb_textbox.text: I went with the idea that the gnomes are split into two groups, earthy colours (brown, green, red, orange) and non earthy (blue, pink, purple, yellow). You seem to get more mushrooms when you choice the earthy coloured gnome, but sometimes this doesnt matter, and the rules change. It is best to pick a non earthy colour when it is x5 points, as there is a better chance of you still getting some points. But like I said, it does change, and sometimes their doesnt seem to be any rules. Good luck
